scope: Synthetic boundary cases for golden-audit-v2. Each prompt and golden is complete. Sources are complete, current, persona-accessible fixture evidence and necessary capabilities are supported unless stated otherwise. Case T deliberately leaves reviewer search coverage incomplete. No unstated rubric, SQL, policy or output requirement applies. Fixed clock: 2026-02-14 00:00, no timezone. These are cases for semantic review, not automated semantic tests.
